bullets: de present perfect continuous vormen met have / has been + -ing

blocks.label: regelmatig werkwoord
examples: I've been waiting for an hour.
Ik sta al een uur te wachten.
Zij wacht al sinds negen uur.
We've been waiting for the bus.
We staan op de bus te wachten.
Zij wachten al de hele dag.

head: Bevestigend
Ontkenning
Vraag
rows: I've been working.
I haven't been working.
Have you been working?
She's been crying.
She hasn't been crying.
Has she been crying?
They've been living here.
They haven't been living here.
How long have they been living here?

head: Gebruik
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: Al een tijd bezig, en nog steeds
I've been learning English for three years.
Ik leer al drie jaar Engels.
Hoe lang?
How long have you been living here?
Hoe lang woon je hier al?
Zichtbaar gevolg van iets recents
Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?
Je ogen zijn rood. Heb je gehuild?
Herhaalde bezigheid tot nu
I've been calling you all morning.
Ik probeer je al de hele ochtend te bellen.

blocks.title: Ik werk hier al drie jaar
blocks.text: Het Nederlands gebruikt de tegenwoordige tijd met al: Ik wacht al een uur. Het Engels zegt dat nooit met de present simple. Gebruik I've been waiting for an hour. I wait since an hour is een typische Nederlandse fout.

head: Present perfect simple
Present perfect continuous
rows: Het resultaat, het aantal: I've read three books this month.
De bezigheid, de duur: I've been reading all afternoon.
Klaar: I've painted the kitchen. (het is af)
Bezig, misschien niet af: I've been painting the kitchen. (er zit verf op mijn handen)
Blijvend: I've lived here all my life.
Tijdelijk: I've been living with friends since May.
Met toestanden: I've known him for years.
Niet met toestanden: I've been knowing him (fout).

blocks.title: How many / how much: simple
blocks.text: Vraag je naar een aantal of hoeveelheid, gebruik dan de simple: How many cups of coffee have you had? Vraag je naar de duur, dan de continuous: How long have you been drinking coffee?

blocks.title: Toestandswerkwoorden
blocks.text: know, like, love, believe, own, be en andere toestandswerkwoorden krijgen geen continuous: I've known her since school, We've been married for ten years.

rows: I wait here since ten o'clock.
I've been waiting here since ten o'clock.
Al een tijd bezig tot nu: present perfect continuous.
I'm learning English for two years.
I've been learning English for two years.
Duur tot nu: niet de present continuous.
She has been knowing him for years.
She has known him for years.
know krijgt geen continuous.
How long are you living here?
How long have you been living here?
Hoe lang al: present perfect continuous.
I've been reading three books.
I've read three books.
Een aantal: present perfect simple.
He has been work all day.
He has been working all day.
Na been komt de -ing-vorm.
We have been waiting since two hours.
We have been waiting for two hours.
Een periode: for.

blocks.text: Vul de present perfect simple of continuous in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: I ______ for you for twenty minutes!
items.full: I have been waiting for you for twenty minutes!

items.q: How long ______ you been learning English?
items.full: How long have you been learning English?

items.q: She ______ all morning. She looks tired.
items.full: She has been working all morning. She looks tired.
I have written four emails today.

items.q: We ______ each other since we were children.
items.full: We have known each other since we were children.
It has been raining since this morning.

items.q: Your hands are dirty. What have you ______ doing?
items.full: Your hands are dirty. What have you been doing?

items.q: They ______ living in Leeds for six months.
items.full: They have been living in Leeds for six months.

items.q: He's been playing the guitar ______ ten years.
items.full: He's been playing the guitar for ten years.

items.q: How many cups of tea ______ you had today?
items.full: How many cups of tea have you had today?

items.q: I ______ my keys. I can't find them anywhere.
items.full: I have lost my keys. I can't find them anywhere.

items.a: I've been waiting for an hour.

items.q: Hoe lang woon je hier al?
items.a: How long have you been living here?

items.q: Het regent al de hele dag.
items.a: It has been raining all day.

items.q: Ik ken haar al tien jaar.
items.a: I have known her for ten years.
